Results.Name: Hundreds of date checks are grouped without deleting or changing a review item
Information can be filtered separately and all original details remain accessible
Shareable diagnostics exclude free text, identifiers, names, paths and secrets
Unrecognized status and settings values cannot inject sensitive text into diagnostics
PDF analysis diagnostics retain counts without copying extracted evidence
Diagnostic exports are atomic new JSON files and protect existing application files
Safe operation history excludes arbitrary old log content and injected fields
Support events remain bounded and do not change saved report data
Standalone diagnostics work against an installation with an active application lock
Pending verification includes provisional daily files and clears only on actual confirmation
Real connection-result handling avoids repeated prompts and remembers only accepted sign-ins

Scope: Synthetic review grouping, diagnostic privacy, protected destinations, safe events, standalone export and active application lock. Production diagnostic CMD runs on Windows.
